name: Claim, evidence and limit
note: The Class XI classroom family for the explain structure: a question about a text, a record or a notice, answered by a claim with evidence and a limit. Literature, history, economics and interpretation reach it (SCHOOL_AND_PROGRESSION.md, Construct an explanation). The method thresholds are chosen: Academics starts at 100,000 milli-XP and the academic_foundation trait adds 10, 25, 45 or 70 XP by rank, so rank 1 reads closely, rank 2 weighs a source and rank 3 reads a table of figures.
